name: sentence_count
description: Count sentences marked by period, exclamation mark or question mark; matched control copies an explicit count in the same prompt.
generator_code:
import random,json
random.seed(0)
items=[]; control=[]
subjects=['Cats','Dogs','Birds','Horses','Children','People','Ducks','Bears']; verbs=['run','sleep','eat','play','move','rest','walk']
for i in range(120):
 n=random.randint(1,6); tag=random.randint(1,6)
 text=' '.join(random.choice(subjects)+' '+random.choice(verbs)+random.choice(['.','!','?']) for _ in range(n))
 ctx=f'Tag: {tag}\nText: {text}\n'
 items.append({'prompt':ctx+'How many sentences are in the text? Answer:', 'answer':' '+str(n)})
 control.append({'prompt':ctx+'What number is the tag? Answer:', 'answer':' '+str(tag)})
json.dump({'items':items,'control':control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
